description:
Ask ChatGPT for an episode about anything, like a briefing on your day from your connected email and calendar, an article you saved, or a topic you want explained before a meeting. Potion narrates it and puts it in a feed you can add to your podcast app, so you can listen on a walk or in the car.

If you like, ChatGPT can make a new one every morning as a scheduled task.

Every episode also has its own page you can send to someone, and they can play it in their browser without an account.

Your feed works in Apple Podcasts, Overcast, Pocket Casts and many other podcast apps.

defaultPrompt: Make me a short briefing on my day from my email and calendar, as an episode for my podcast app.
Explain how interest rates work in a short episode I can listen to later.
Make my mum a short episode on what a statin does, and give me a link I can send her.
